extracted.intended_audience: media, journalists, and PR professionals covering the NHL
extracted.subtask_description: A season-specific (2024-25) media guide listing NHL on-ice officials, off-ice staff, resources, pronunciation guidance, and career/statistical tables for referees and linespersons. Intended to be used as the authoritative reference for media materials and communications about officials.

rubrics_metrics.name: NHL Rulebook (resource)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed under RESOURCES as an authoritative source for rules. Use the NHL Rulebook when referencing or explaining rules in media pieces about officiating.

rubrics_metrics.name: NHL Video Rulebook (resource)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed under RESOURCES as a visual/clarifying complement to the written rulebook. Use the NHL Video Rulebook for illustrative/technical explanations of rule applications in coverage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Records.nhl.com – 2024-25 NHL Officials (statistical reference)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed under RESOURCES; use the NHL records site as the authoritative source for officials' career and season statistics cited in stories or press materials.

rubrics_metrics.name: Real-time rule clarifications (official channel)
rubrics_metrics.description: For real-time rule clarifications, please follow @PR_NHL or visit NHL.com/situationroom
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Direct instruction for media to consult the NHL's official real-time channels (@PR_NHL and NHL.com/situationroom) when seeking live clarifications about rule interpretations or in-game decisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: NHL Communications contact for officials
rubrics_metrics.description: NHL Communications contact for NHL Officials and Officiating Staff: Jennifer Moad (jmoad@nhl.com)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides the specific communications contact to be used for media inquiries related to officials and officiating staff; use this contact for official statements, interviews, or clarifications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pronunciation guide
rubrics_metrics.description: PRONUNCIATION GUIDE (lists phonetic pronunciations for officials' names)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The guide supplies pronunciations (e.g., 'BEECH, KOH-dee') for on-ice officials. Media/broadcasters should use the provided pronunciations when announcing or printing officials' names to ensure accuracy and consistency.

rubrics_metrics.name: Authoritative roster and role listings
rubrics_metrics.description: 2024-25 ON-ICE OFFICIALS — lists referees and linespersons with names, numbers, and roles (including designation '* Minor league team member').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use this roster as the official listing of on-ice officials for the 2024-25 season when identifying personnel in press materials; note special designations (e.g., minor league members) and assigned numbers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Officials' game and career statistics (tables)
rubrics_metrics.description: Tables listing Regular Season Games, First Regular Season Game, Playoff Games, First Playoff Game, and career aggregates (e.g., Most Regular Season Games, Most Playoff Games, Stanley Cup Final Games, Outdoor Games, All-Star Games).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the provided statistical tables as the authoritative source for officials' game counts and milestones when writing bios, features, or historical comparisons. The document explicitly provides counts and first-game dates for individual officials and all-time leaderboards.
